I'm sorry your item arrived damaged. Order 1008 was placed 45 days ago, and our refund window is 30 days for paid orders, so I can't request a refund for it through the standard process.

If you'd like, I can send your damaged-item claim to a human reviewer to look at whether an exception applies. Please note that a reviewer's decision isn't guaranteed. Would you like me to do that?
